sections.Profile:
"Fathom," released by Bally in 1981, is a classic pinball machine designed by Ward Pemberton with artwork by Greg Freres and Kevin O'Connor. This game features an underwater theme with mermaids and sea monsters. It has three flippers, three pop bumpers, multiple drop targets, and a three-ball multiball mode, offering a richly detailed and engaging gameplay experience.
